children: Just a few short weeks ago at this fall’s Stansberry Alliance conference amid the desert heat and electric glow of Las Vegas, my fellow analysts and I were given a challenge: Name the single stock we’d most want to own heading into 2027.
As I stopped to consider the thousands of stocks blinking across my trading screens, one name stood above the rest: Rubrik, Inc. (RBRK).
AI is making cyberattacks faster and more sophisticated. And when attackers break through, businesses need a reliable way to restore their data and get critical systems back online.
This past week alone, headlines were filled with major IT outages, cyberattacks, and security breaches affecting some of the biggest names in business and government.
Helping high-powered organizations recover from these types of disruptions is where Rubrik excels.

I’ve been following this sector closely on Masters in Trading: LIVE. And after Palo Alto Networks, Inc. (PANW) reported its latest earnings, I wanted to revisit where the money is going and why Rubrik remains my number-one name.
Why Cybersecurity Stocks Are Getting My Attention
When I look for a trade, I start with the sector. Where is the money flowing? Which businesses are showing strength even when the broader market gets hit? Then I dig into the individual companies.

On November 18, Palo Alto Networks reported fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue of $3.44 billion, up 39% from a year earlier. Its next-generation security annual recurring revenue reached $9.73 billion, up 66%, according to the company’s earnings release. That is a powerful indication of customer demand, even though it does not tell us what any one stock will do next.

The bigger story is AI. Companies are adding AI tools, agents and new ways to access data. Attackers are getting new tools, too. Businesses cannot simply hope their defenses will hold forever. They need to prepare for what happens when those defenses fail.
Rubrik Stock (RBRK): Why I Like the Recovery Business

Think about the different jobs in cybersecurity. Some companies manage who gets access. Others protect devices, secure networks or look for vulnerabilities. Rubrik operates in a different lane: getting critical data and systems back after something goes wrong.

A business that cannot recover its data after a ransomware attack has a serious problem, no matter how much it spent trying to prevent the attack in the first place. The way I see it, that gives Rubrik a compelling role as cybersecurity spending grows.

But you don’t have to take my word for it alone. Let’s take a look at the most recent earnings report and let the numbers tell the story. In its fiscal second quarter ended July 31, 2026, Rubrik reported subscription annual recurring revenue of $1.66 billion, up 33% year over year, according to the company’s August 27 earnings release. Quarterly revenue rose 38% to $427.3 million, and the company reported a 15% free cash flow margin.
Numbers like these are what I want to see when I’m looking beyond a stock’s day-to-day moves. They do not make Rubrik risk-free, but they help explain why I keep coming back to it.
Why I Don’t Buy Every Cybersecurity Stock

On my November 19 live show, I divided cybersecurity into different buckets: identity, endpoints and cloud servers, network access, vulnerability detection and recovery. You can own several cybersecurity stocks and still end up concentrated in companies that do essentially the same job.

That is why I like to understand what each company does before I decide how much exposure I want. I also discussed cybersecurity ETFs, including the Amplify Cybersecurity ETF (HACK) and Global X Cybersecurity ETF (BUG), as ways to spread exposure across multiple businesses. An ETF offers diversification, but it will not give you the same exposure as choosing Rubrik directly.

If you want to see how I break down a sector, compare the companies and think about entry points, join me on free Masters in Trading: LIVE. I go live on market days to discuss the stocks and market conditions I’m watching.
How I’d Buy Rubrik Stock: Entry Points and Tranches
I love the Rubrik story. But I am also a big believer in entry points. A great company can still be a painful trade if you chase it after a big move or commit too much money at one price.

That is why I talked about buying in tranches during Thursday’s presentation. Instead of putting your entire intended investment into a stock at once, you can tranche in and build a position in stages. This approach can help give you some flexibility if and when the market pulls back.

The broader market matters, too. During that same show, I was watching the VVIX, a measure of expected volatility in the VIX. I wanted to see it fall below 100 before becoming more confident in a broad market rally.
Rubrik faces competition, valuation risk and the possibility that growth slows. I want to respect those risks while keeping the bigger cybersecurity opportunity in view.
Is Rubrik Stock a Buy for 2027?

Rubrik is still my favorite cybersecurity name going into 2027. I like the company’s position in cyber recovery, its recurring subscription business and the growth in its latest reported quarter. I also want to be smart about price and position size.

I’ve covered the broader sector before, including smaller companies that could benefit from the same spending trend. If you want to compare Rubrik with other names, start with 5 Small-Cap Cybersecurity Stocks With 5x Potential and The 15 Best Cybersecurity Stocks to Buy Whether AI Booms or Busts.
I also walked through the cybersecurity watchlist and my Rubrik thesis on November 19. You can watch that full Masters in Trading: LIVE episode below.
Rubrik Stock: Frequently Asked Questions
What does Rubrik do? Rubrik provides cyber resilience tools that help organizations protect, secure and recover their data and systems, including after cyber incidents.

Why do I like Rubrik stock for 2027? I like its focus on recovery after a breach and its subscription growth. Rubrik reported 33% year-over-year subscription ARR growth in its fiscal second quarter of 2027.

What are the risks of investing in Rubrik stock? Competition, valuation, slower growth and broad market volatility can all pressure RBRK shares. A strong cybersecurity outlook does not guarantee a higher stock price.
Follow the Next Cybersecurity Setup With Me

I plan to keep watching cybersecurity as we move into 2027. Earnings can change the picture, and a market pullback can change the entry. That is why I prefer to follow these opportunities in real time.
